title: Joomla Extension - virtuemart.net - Unauthenticated local file inclusion leading to remote code execution via…
description: A critical vulnerability in the Joomla VirtueMart extension versions 4.0.0 through 4.8.7 allows unauthenticated attackers to perform local file inclusion via the main controller fallback mechanism. This flaw enables path traversal to arbitrary local PHP files, potentially leading to remote code execution depending on the server environment. The vulnerability has been exploited in the wild and was fixed in version 4.8.8.
